heuristics.name: odd-one-out
heuristics.description: pick the option whose sense or polarity differs from the other three

heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: when two options are opposites, the key is likely one of them (pick the less ordinary/odd one)

heuristics.name: coherent-pair
heuristics.description: two-blank: pick the pair whose halves relate most naturally (same direction or a clean contrast)

heuristics.name: shared-word
heuristics.description: two-blank: a word repeated in two options marks the key pair; pick the contrasting variant

heuristics.name: harder-word
heuristics.description: pick the most specialised vocabulary word

notes: Options-only. Most signals are weak structural priors (odd-one-out, antonym pairs); none certain, so reject_certain false throughout. Many single-word sets have no discernible signal.
